cases.title: Verify both Classic and Modern themes exist under preferences (Normal)
cases.description: Navigate to the themes preferences and verify that both Classic and Modern themes are present in the list.

cases.title: Verify theme list is populated exclusively with expected themes (Edge)
cases.description: Check the themes preferences to ensure the theme list contains only the expected themes without unexpected additions.

cases.title: Verify exactly two themes are available under preferences (Boundary)
cases.description: Count the total number of available themes under the themes preferences and verify there are exactly two.

cases.title: Verify system behavior when theme files are missing (Error/Abnormal)
cases.description: Simulate missing theme files in the application directory and check that the preferences handle the missing assets gracefully.

cases.title: Classic theme visual verification
cases.description: Verify that the Classic theme is displayed correctly as in the given reference image.

cases.title: Classic theme at minimum resolution
cases.description: Verify that the Classic theme is rendered correctly when displayed on the minimum supported window resolution.

cases.title: Classic theme with font scaling limits
cases.description: Verify that the Classic theme renders correctly at the boundary condition of system font scaling limits.

cases.title: Classic theme with corrupted asset
cases.description: Verify system behavior and error handling when the Classic theme asset is corrupted.

cases.title: Modern Theme Display Normal
cases.description: Verify that the Modern theme is displayed correctly matching the given reference image.

cases.title: Modern Theme Display Edge
cases.description: Verify that the Modern theme is correctly rendered when the application is displayed on maximum window resolution.

cases.title: Modern Theme Display Boundary
cases.description: Verify that the Modern theme renders correctly with high-contrast OS settings enabled.

cases.title: Modern Theme Display Abnormal
cases.description: Verify application behavior and error handling when the image asset for the Modern theme is missing.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item normal presence in View menu
cases.description: Verify that the Theme Preferences item is present and selectable under the View menu during normal usage.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item via keyboard shortcut
cases.description: Verify that the View menu can be opened and Theme Preferences accessed using keyboard shortcuts as an edge case.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences menu boundary position
cases.description: Verify the boundary condition where Theme Preferences is positioned as the last item in the View menu list.

cases.title: Verify View menu abnormal failure to render
cases.description: Verify system behavior when the View menu fails to render, ensuring proper handling of the missing Theme Preferences item.

cases.title: Normal scenario for Get New Themes menu item
cases.description: Verify that the Get New Themes item is present and selectable under the View menu.

cases.title: Edge scenario for Get New Themes menu item
cases.description: Verify the behavior when selecting Get New Themes while the system is offline.

cases.title: Boundary scenario for Get New Themes menu item
cases.description: Verify that Get New Themes is positioned directly below Theme Preferences in the View menu list.

cases.title: Error scenario for Get New Themes menu item
cases.description: Verify the system handles network timeouts gracefully when selecting Get New Themes.

cases.title: Verify Classic item present in View menu (Normal)
cases.description: Verify that the Classic item is present in the View menu and can be successfully identified.

cases.title: Select Classic item while Modern is active (Edge)
cases.description: Verify that selecting the Classic item from the View menu while the Modern theme is currently active successfully switches the theme.

cases.title: Verify Classic item placement in menu (Boundary)
cases.description: Verify that the Classic item is placed correctly at the top of the theme submenu or list structure.

cases.title: Classic item click event unhandled (Error)
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when the click event on the Classic item is unhandled or fails to execute.

cases.title: Verify Modern item is present in View menu
cases.description: Ensure that the "Modern" item is available as a selectable option under the View menu.

cases.title: Select Modern item while Classic is active
cases.description: Click the "Modern" item under the View menu while the Classic theme is currently active and verify the theme switches.

cases.title: Verify Modern item placement in View menu
cases.description: Check that the "Modern" item is positioned correctly adjacent to the Classic item within the menu structure.

cases.title: Handle unhandled click event on Modern item
cases.description: Simulate an unhandled click event on the "Modern" item under the View menu and verify the application remains stable.

opinions.feedback: All requirements (R-175 through R-181) have comprehensive test cases covering normal, edge, boundary, and error scenarios. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: Unit ID: firefox_themes. R-175: Normal - Both Classic and Modern themes exist under preferences. Edge - Theme list populated with only expected themes. Boundary - Exactly two themes available. Abnormal - Missing theme files. R-176: Normal - Classic theme matches reference image. Edge - Classic theme rendered on minimum window resolution. Boundary - Classic theme rendering with system font scaling limits. Abnormal - Corrupted theme asset for Classic. R-177: Normal - Modern theme matches reference image. Edge - Modern theme rendered on maximum window resolution. Boundary - Modern theme rendering with high-contrast OS settings. Abnormal - Missing image asset for Modern theme. R-178: Normal - Theme Preferences item present in View menu. Edge - View menu opened with keyboard shortcut. Boundary - Theme Preferences as the last item in View menu list. Abnormal - View menu failing to render. R-179: Normal - Get New Themes item present in View menu. Edge - Click Get New Themes while offline. Boundary - Get New Themes placed directly below Theme Preferences. Abnormal - Network timeout when selecting Get New Themes. R-180: Normal - Classic item present in View menu. Edge - Select Classic item while Modern is active. Boundary - Classic item placed at top of theme submenu. Abnormal - Classic item click event unhandled. R-181: Normal - Modern item present in View menu. Edge - Select Modern item while Classic is active. Boundary - Modern item placed adjacent to Classic item. Abnormal - Modern item click event unhandled.
